public=公开域名，永久有效；presigned=签名链接，到期失效: public = public domain, never expires; presigned = signed link, expires
一份实现覆盖 MinIO / 阿里云 OSS / 腾讯 COS / Cloudf: One implementation covers S3-compatible services such as MinIO, Alibaba Cloud OSS, Tencent COS and Cloudflare R2 —
上一页返回的 marker；空=从头: The marker returned by the previous page; empty = start from the beginning
仅签名链接用；公开域名链接忽略它: Only used for signed links; ignored for public-domain links
公开桶或绑了 CDN 时填，链接永久有效；留空则签发限时直连链接: Set this for a public bucket or one fronted by a CDN, giving a link that never expires; leave blank to issue a time-limited direct link instead
列一次对象（最多 1 条）验证密钥、桶名与区域是否配对: Lists objects once (at most 1) to verify the key, bucket name and region match up
取对象的可直接访问链接：公开域名（永久）或签名链接（限时）；都不支持则报错，平台: Gets a directly accessible link for the object: a public-domain link (permanent) or a signed link (time-limited); if neither is supported, this errors and the platform falls back to proxied download
平台文件引用；字节由插件经文件通道拉取: A platform file reference; the bytes are pulled by the plugin through the file channel
把一个平台文件写进桶；同 key 覆盖: Writes a platform file into the bucket; overwrites on the same key
把桶里的对象取回为平台文件引用: Retrieves an object from the bucket as a platform file reference
按 key 批量删除；已不存在的视为成功（幂等）: Batch-deletes by key; keys that no longer exist are treated as success (idempotent)
按前缀列出桶内对象；marker 翻页（对账靠它扫全桶）: Lists objects in the bucket by prefix, paginated with a marker (used for reconciliation to scan the whole bucket)
查单个对象的大小/类型/ETag；不存在时 exists=false（不是报错）: Looks up a single object's size/type/ETag; exists=false when it does not exist (not an error)
空=取 key 的最后一段: Empty = use the last segment of the key
自建（MinIO 等）用 true；AWS 官方用 false: Use true for self-hosted (e.g. MinIO); use false for official AWS
